item.name: OKF Scrape
item.description: Scrape jobs. Requests run in order: dryRun starts a job and saves {{jobId}}; the commit request then hits 409 because that job is still running. Run the commit request on its own (no active job, OPENAI_API_KEY + DESCRIPTION_MODEL set) to write the bundle; it then returns 202.

item.name: POST scrape gdpr (commit) — 409 while a job runs

request.description: Writes the bundle (LLM descriptions for added/updated docs). 202 when no gdpr job is active; 409 while one is.

item.name: POST scrape gdpr (redescribe, dryRun) — 409 while a job runs

request.description: Lists unchanged docs whose description would be rewritten from the current source (template or DESCRIPTION_MODEL). Drop dryRun to rewrite them. 202 when no gdpr job is active; 409 while one is.

item.name: OKF Scrape — EU AI Act
item.description: EU AI Act scrape jobs (consolidated text as amended by Reg. (EU) 2026/1744; Art. 1–96 + 4a, 60a, 75a–75d; Annex I–X). Runs alongside a GDPR job (409 is per regulation). dryRun saves {{aiJobId}}; the commit request then hits 409 while that job runs — send it on its own to write the bundle (202).

exec: pm.test('status 202 (independent of a running gdpr job)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(202));
pm.test('job is the eu-ai-act job', () => { pm.expect(job.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('aiJobId')); pm.expect(job.reg).to.eql('eu-ai-act'); });

if (job.status === 'done') pm.test('result ids are eu-ai-act ids', () => [...job.result.added, ...job.result.updated, ...job.result.skipped].forEach((id) => pm.expect(id).to.match(/^eu-ai-act:(ch-\d{2}|art-\d{3}[a-z]?|rec-\d{3}|annex-[ivx]+)$/)));
